title: Docs hypersprint notes & quick fixes
body:
Hypersprint morning dump (short, noisy) - Rachel

Context:
- Weekend-run mini push to clear highest-impact tutorial bugs and sample-app gaps before next intake. Keep this doc as my running check-in — will convert to PR checklist later.
- Focus areas: quick tutorial flow fixes, SDK sample-apps that fail for first-time users, and a couple of docs that confuse customers re: Dedicated vs Hosted routing.

Immediate triage (top of mind):
1) JS quickstart example failing on `npm run start` (reported by QA)
   - Repro: clone sdk-js/examples/chat, npm i, env var REDWOOD_API_KEY unset -> app crashes with cryptic error stack: "TypeError: cannot read property 'slice' of undefined"
   - Suspect: code assumes process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY exists; should surface friendly error and fallback to local mock for dev (or clear instruction in README).
   - Action: add explicit check + helpful error message in example index.js. (ETA: 1h)
   - Linked PR: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/218 (WIP)

2) Python embeddings tutorial: subtle mismatch between model name in code and table in doc
   - Problem: README uses model "rm-embedding-xsmall" but code snippet references "embed-small". New users pick wrong model and get 404 from API.
   - Quick fix: unify doc code block to use the canonical model id and add a Troubleshooting note.
   - Ticket: DOCS-4123 (blocking sample-app demo at event)

3) Sample app manifest for `todos` app missing port forward note for Dedicated mode
   - Impact: Enterprise customer trying Dedicated on a private cluster couldn't reach the app; they assumed console sets up ingress automatically.
   - Fix: add short paragraph in sample-app README about p-ports and kubeport-forward example. Also include terraform snippet for common network policy. (ETA: 2h)

Micro to-dos (today):
- [ ] Patch js example to check env var and print friendly hint + link to console docs. (pair with Aria)
- [ ] Update python embedding tutorial to canonical model id + add troubleshooting block.
- [ ] Add dedicated-mode note to sample-apps/todos/README.md including kube forward command.
- [ ] Draft one-paragraph blurb explaining "Routing tiers (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)" for the quickstart overview page — highlight fallback behavior.
- [ ] Run smoke on examples locally (mac M1) and on an intel linux CI runner. Capture any platform-specific npm/build issues.

Notes to self / friction spots seen repeatedly:
- Error messages in example apps often assume infra is available; need standardized dev-mode guard that prints "Using mock client - to connect to Redwood API set REDWOOD_API_KEY or run 'redwood-local start'".
- Many examples show `await client.generate()` but do not show installation of peer deps (e.g., ws for streaming). Add short "Prereqs" section to each sample-app README.
- Console docs reference route-level fallbacks but examples don't demonstrate the automatic downgrade to smaller quantized models when Dedicated capacity is low. Could add a short demo notebook showing latency/cost tradeoffs.

Questions / gating items:
- Can we add a centralized `examples/dev-helpers` small module in every language repo that exports `checkApiKey()` and `startLocalMock()`? Pros: single change fixes many samples. Cons: cross-repo churn; need maintainers' buy-in. Ask: @mika for opinion.
- Are we ok shipping the friendly error now as a stopgap without full mock? (Yes, non-breaking)

Followups / handoffs:
- Aria: help me pair on the JS edit this afternoon — I will open a small branch and assign.
- Mika: quick thumbs up on centralized dev-helpers approach and whether we should expose it as a packaged dev-dep.
- Docs review: ping `#docs-review` channel after PRs so tech writers can sanity-check wording.

Scratch timeline (planned):
- 15:00 — 16:00: implement JS friendly error + create PR
- 16:00 — 16:30: run smoke tests on mac + CI runner
- 16:30 — 17:30: update python tutorial + todos README edits, push commits
- 17:30 — 18:00: quick PR descriptions, link to DOCS-4123, request reviews

Quick snippets to paste into PRs:
- JS env guard (one-liner):
  if (!process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY) throw new Error('REDWOOD_API_KEY not set. For local dev use the mock server: https://go.redwood.dev/local-mock');

- Troubleshooting blurb for embedding mismatch:
  "If you see a 404 when calling embeddings, confirm the model id in your code exactly matches the 'Model name' in the table above. Common mistake: using 'embed-small' instead of 'rm-embedding-xsmall'."

Random todos (parking lot):
- Create a tiny "first-run" smoke test (GitHub Actions) that runs each example's install + start for 30s and reports failure. Low-effort but will catch regressions.
- Collect 3-4 user-facing pain points and propose wording for a single onboarding doc.

End of dump. Will tidy and convert to checklist after first PRs land.

-- R
